title: Follow the Light with Tegan Kline
author: Tegan Kline
description: Welcome to Follow the Light w Tegan Kline Our souls come here to become like the light & choose the light! Follow the Light is a podcast devoted to those of us illuminating the world. Through heartfelt conversations, sometimes I’ll speak directly to you, and sometimes I’ll sit down with people who embody the light of the Creator in how they live, heal, build and serve — acting as God’s hands and living vessels for something greater. Come with me as we follow the light, together. Make to subscribe here and on YouTube, Instagram & TikTok @TheKlineVenture; Tegan Kline on Facebook.
